dedupe_keys.name: myanmar transport layers from mimu geonode road network 2022 railway network 2022 bridges over 180 ft airports and seaports

description: The Myanmar Information Management Unit (MIMU) publishes national transport layers on its GeoNode for humanitarian and development planning. Contents: the road network 2022 (1,145 main, secondary and tertiary road segments built on a connectivity approach linking the Union capital, state and region capitals, towns and villages); the railway network 2022 (76 line features updated in March 2022 from satellite imagery and Ministry of Transport and Communications information); 986 larger bridges over 180 feet, located by CDE Myanmar and MIMU from the 2019 General Administration Department township profiles and satellite imagery; 65 airports with operational status; and 11 seaports and deep-sea port projects with port type and source. Producer: MIMU, with CDE Myanmar for bridges. Coverage: the whole of Myanmar at about 1:250,000. Format and access: GeoNode layers with WMS and WFS, downloadable as GeoJSON, shapefile or CSV without registration. Licence: no licence is stated on the layers; MIMU products are shared with attribution. Caveats: the railway status is not verified and parts may be out of service after landslides or conflict; the road layer is a connectivity network, not a surveyed road inventory; bridge positions are approximate. Simulation uses: access and isolation analysis for humanitarian logistics, flood and cyclone exposure of bridges and roads, and network models of freight routes to ports. Related records: MIMU public hospitals (data-myanmar-public-hospitals-mimu) and the substations layer (data-mimu-myanmar-electric-power-substations-2025) come from the same GeoNode.
